message: Nothing was changed: 2 blocks cannot be mirrored: 2 blocks with a rotary axis away from 0. Machine 'Mill extra axes': it does not say how it reads numbers, so a word whose reading depends on that would refuse the run.

findings.message: N80 G1 Y10 QQ90: a rotary axis moves to an angle other than 0 here, or stands at one; turning or mirroring the path would need its angle changed too, which gEdit does not do.
N90 G1 X30 AA=25: a rotary axis moves to an angle other than 0 here, or stands at one; turning or mirroring the path would need its angle changed too, which gEdit does not do.
